about: Comparison questions whose honest answer depends on when each series has values. Scoring is pass/fail per check; a question passes when every check passes. Truth was measured with describe_sampling on 2026-11-10.

questions.question: Compare forereef bottom temperature at 30 m across the LTER sites in 2020.
questions.truth: Forereef 30 m in 2020: LTER_0 all year; LTER_3 to 10 Sep, LTER_4 to 9 Sep, LTER_5 to 14 Sep, LTER_6 to 11 Sep. LTER_1 and LTER_2 have no 30 m record in 2020.

checks.text: Notes that most 30 m loggers stop in early or mid September 2020 (all but LTER_0).
Notes that LTER_1 and LTER_2 have no 30 m data in 2020.
Does not give counts as a percentage of nominal slots or days.
Compares matching months (January to early September), or says the months differ.

questions.question: Compare forereef seawater pH between 2017 and 2018.
questions.truth: Hourly records. 2017: 16–27 Apr and 2 Sep–31 Dec only. 2018: January to 25 Jan, then 26 Apr–16 Dec (two-day gap in July). Matching months: September–December (and late April).

checks.text: Notes that 2017 has no records from late April to early September (or covers only late April and September–December).
Notes that 2018 has no records from late January to late April.
Does not give counts as a percentage of nominal hours or slots.
Compares matching months (September–December), or says the months differ.

questions.question: Compare upstream water temperature at the LTER_1 and LTER_2 reef-metabolism transects from 2007 to 2025.
questions.truth: The record is short instrument deployments, not a continuous series: 1–2 per site per year, each 3–18 days at 1-minute readings, in January–March and May–June. LTER_2 starts in 2009 (none in 2007–2008). Neither site has data in 2018; LTER_2 has none in 2017 either (LTER_1 has 12–17 January 2017). A yearly mean mixes January and May–June deployments, so compare matching deployments or months. Measured 2026-11-10 from the stored table.

checks.text: Says the data are short deployments (days), not a continuous record.
Says LTER_2 starts in 2009.
Notes that there is no 2018 data (and none at LTER_2 in 2017).
Compares matching months or deployments, or says January and May–June deployments differ.
Does not give counts as a percentage of nominal slots or coverage.

questions.question: Give me the weekly mean ADCP wave height at FOR04 in 2013, and point out any gaps in the record.
questions.truth: ADCP records from 1 Jan 2013 (every 3 h; 1,485 records in 29 weeks with data). Gaps longer than a day: 13–22 Jan (9.4 days), 9 Jul–5 Aug (26.9 days) and 10 Aug–31 Dec (142.8 days; one record on 31 Dec). Weeks with no data have no mean; nothing is filled.

checks.text: Names the gap from about 9 July to 5 August 2013.
Notes no data from mid-August to the end of 2013.
Notes the 13–22 January gap.
Does not give counts as a percentage of nominal slots, bins or days.

questions.question: Compare backreef (1–2 m) bottom temperature at LTER 1, LTER 4 and LTER 6 in 2020.
questions.table: data_0928fdb533c118 (btm_daily, zone 'Backreef 1–2 m') or data_69c1f240c8d3f6 / data_556e38973e3f4f
questions.truth: Daily records. LTER_1 all year. LTER_6 has no data 11 Jan–18 Aug 2020; LTER_4 has no data 15 Aug–26 Sep. Days all three share: 1–10 Jan and 27 Sep–31 Dec (106 days); mean daily temp_mean over them LTER_1 27.78, LTER_4 27.68, LTER_6 27.73 °C (27 Sep–31 Dec only: 27.76, 27.65, 27.71).

checks.text: Notes that LTER 6 has no data from mid-January to mid-August 2020.
Notes that LTER 4 has no data from mid-August to late September 2020.
Compares the days or months all three share, or says the periods differ.
Does not give counts as a percentage of nominal slots, bins or days.

questions.question: Was the ADCP wave height at FOR04 higher in 2016 or in 2017?
questions.truth: 2016: records 14 Jan–16 Aug (plus one on 31 Dec). 2017: from 8 Jul only. Whole-year means (1.276 m vs 1.251 m) are not comparable. Over the month-days both years have (8 Jul–16 Aug and 31 Dec): 2016 1.247 m (316 records), 2017 1.256 m (324 records): about the same, 2017 marginally higher.

checks.text: Notes that 2017 has data only from early July.
Notes that 2016 has no data after mid-August.
Gives the 2016 mean over exactly the month-days both years have (1.247 m for 8 Jul–16 Aug, with or without 31 Dec), not a window that differs between years.
Compares the July–August days both years have, or says the years are not comparable as a whole.
Does not give counts as a percentage of nominal slots, bins or days.
